business_problem: NOS needed to modernize its telecom platform around APIs, cloud-native compute, and AI-driven operations so it could process very large transaction volumes and automate more customer interactions without remaining tied to slower legacy delivery models.
solution_summary: NOS transformed its technology stack on Google Cloud by combining a data-mesh approach with API-first infrastructure and cloud-native runtime services. Google Kubernetes Engine became a core platform for pipelines, APIs, and services, while Apigee scaled to more than one hundred proxies across five environments processing over a billion transactions per month. Around those pillars, NOS incorporated Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Armor to support modern service delivery and data-driven AI workflows. The company also established a Cloud Center of Excellence so infrastructure, data, and AI adoption could evolve together rather than in isolated migrations. This architecture helped NOS automate customer interactions, reduce resolution times, and reframe the telco as an agile platform business where APIs, data products, and generative AI services share a common Google Cloud foundation.

solution_components.name: BigQuery

data_flow: APIs, pipelines, and services run on GKE and Apigee, while events move through Pub/Sub and serverless components on Cloud Run. Data products and analytics are stored in BigQuery and feed AI-driven service improvements across customer interaction flows.
business_outcome: NOS modernized its core delivery platform, automated more customer interactions, and created a scalable cloud-and-data foundation that supports faster service improvement and higher API throughput.
